narrative: 画框的一角卷了起来，下面露出另一层，或者露出街道本身。
当身份是某种贴上去的东西、而“揭掉它”就是这场戏的节拍时使用它：片头字幕、一张海报、一张作为不干胶的脸。对于一场打斗，或者一幅只是层层叠加静态图像、没有“揭起”这个动作的拼贴画来说，这就用错了工具。
如果各种媒介作为平等的来源相互碰撞，那是混合媒介。如果撕碎的纸张静止不动，那是拼贴。
这个技巧则带有卷曲的边缘和胶水的高光反射。
how: 搭建一个带有纸张纹理或乙烯基光泽的模切图层。为一个方向的揭起动作制作动画。
展示图层背面粘胶的光泽，以及揭开后露出的底衬。手的出现与否可选。
保持贴纸上的脸或物体清晰可辨。用一个小型强光源为卷起的边缘打光，让边缘产生一点高光。
提示词：a sticker peel on the subject: the image lifting from a backing, adhesive shine。对于视频，一层贴纸剥落，露出下面的另一层。
when: 用于片头字幕、身份笑话，或揭示海报底下藏着什么的段落。不要把它当作一场依然需要清晰地理关系的追逐戏中的转场。
vs: 拼贴把图像层层叠加，没有“揭起”这个动作；混合媒介让不同的采集方式相互碰撞。
贴纸撕起则是一个单独的、有厚度、会卷曲、带胶水的图形图层，从底衬上剥离。
examples_film: 片头设计和动态图形是最常见的应用场景：一个像标签一样的片头字幕、一次街头艺术式的撕扯、一张从墙上剥落的乙烯基贴纸。这是“纸张即物质”的语法，不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是布景里的一张普通海报。破绽是没有卷曲、没有胶水、没有模切边缘。
解决办法是一个正在剥离的图层、粘胶的高光反射，以及底下的揭示。

faq.q: 电影中的贴纸撕起是什么？
faq.a: 贴纸撕起像揭标签一样把图像从底衬上剥离。你能看到厚度、卷曲和粘胶的光泽。画面是从这个世界上被揭下来的。

faq.q: 贴纸撕起 vs 拼贴
faq.a: 拼贴是静态图像的层层叠加；贴纸撕起是一次“揭起”事件：一个模切图层从底衬上卷落。一个是静止的图层，另一个是胶水与卷曲。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用贴纸撕起？
faq.a: 用于片头字幕、身份笑话，以及揭示海报底下的内容。对于依然需要真实房间和真实摄影机路径的动作戏，就跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写贴纸撕起的提示词？
faq.a: 写下 "Sticker peel on [Subject], the image lifting from a backing, adhesive shine"。对于视频，一层图层剥落，露出另一层。说明卷曲的方向和底衬。

narrative: A corner of the frame rolls. Underneath is another layer or the street.

Use it when identity is something stuck on, and removing it is the beat: titles, a poster, a face as vinyl. It is the wrong tool for a fight, and for a collage that only layers stills without a peel event.
If media collide as equal sources, that is mixed media. If torn paper sits still, that is collage.
This one has a curl and a specular of adhesive.
how: Build a die-cut layer with paper tooth or vinyl gloss. Animate one peel direction.
Show the adhesive shine on the underside and the backing that is revealed. A hand is optional.
Keep the face or object on the sticker readable. Light the curl with a small hard source so the edge has a tick.
Prompt a sticker peel on the subject: the image lifting from a backing, adhesive shine. For video, a sticker layer peels off, revealing another layer.
when: Use it for titles, identity jokes, a reveal of what was under the poster. Do not use it as a transition in a chase that still needs geography.
vs: Collage layers images without a peel. Mixed Media collides capture modes.
Sticker peel is a single graphic layer with thickness, curl, and glue, coming off a backing.
examples_film: Title design and motion graphics are the well-known uses: a credit that is a label, a street-art rip, a vinyl coming off a wall. Grammar of paper as matter, not frames to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a poster in the set. The tell is no curl, no glue, no die-cut edge.
The fix is a lifting layer, adhesive specular, and a reveal underneath.

faq.q: What is sticker peel in film?
faq.a: Sticker peel lifts the image from a backing like a label. You see thickness, curl, and adhesive shine. The picture comes off the world.
Collage stacks stills. Sticker peel is a peel event: one die-cut layer rolling off a backing. One is layers at rest. The other is glue and curl.

faq.q: When should I use sticker peel?
faq.a: Use it for titles, identity jokes, a reveal under a poster. Skip it in action that still needs a real room and a real camera path.

faq.q: How do I prompt sticker peel for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Sticker peel on [Subject], the image lifting from a backing, adhesive shine. For video, a layer peels off, revealing another. Name curl direction and backing.
